points.text: A roof collapsed during classes at a private school in Peshawar, killing at least 27 students and a teacher and injuring more than 50 people in some reports.
A shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, killed three children and one adult; reports said the suspected gunman also died.
The White House and Pentagon have prepared plans that could include a MOAB strike on potential targets in Iran if President Trump orders an attack.
Ukraine resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries, citing Russian violations of a ceasefire on energy targets, while tensions with the United States have risen.
A 19-year-old was arrested in Illinois over an alleged plan to carry out a mass shooting at a Hindu temple after a coworker alerted police.
